items.question: Where has Tiffany Mitchell played in the WNBA?
items.answer: WNBA guard Tiffany Mitchell has played for the Indiana Fever (2016 to 2022), Minnesota Lynx (2023), Connecticut Sun (2024), Las Vegas Aces (2025) and Seattle Storm, who signed her in July 2025. Indiana drafted her ninth overall in 2016.

items.question: How old is WNBA guard Tiffany Mitchell?
items.answer: WNBA guard Tiffany Mitchell was born September 23, 1994, in Charlotte, North Carolina.

items.question: What did Tiffany Mitchell do at South Carolina?
items.answer: Tiffany Mitchell was a three-time All-American at South Carolina, a two-time SEC Player of the Year, including 2015. She scored 1,885 points, and the school retired her No. 25 jersey in 2023.
